text:
waiting for death

like a cat

that will jump onto the

bed.


I am sorry for

my wife.

She will see this

body

stiff

and white.


She will shake it once, then

perhaps again:

"Hank"

Hank will not

answer.


It is not my death that

worries me, it is my wife

alone with this

pile of nothing.


I want her to know

that every night

sleeping beside her.

Even the useless

arguments

were splendid

things.


And the hard

words

I was always afraid to

say

can now be

said:


"I love you"

translation.title: Confession
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the deathbed tenderness and the final words withheld until after death.
